g.text: 1. Stabiliser C-105 is in LPG service: class C1 (600#), fire-safe valves, area gas detection (F&G).
2. Column pressure by hot-vapour bypass PV-1091; reboiler HP steam cut by SIF-110 (XV-1096).
3. E-116 kettle: stabilised naphtha overflows weir to E-114; HP condensate pot level LIC-1098.
4. SIF-109: D-105 low-low level (LT-1092B) closes XV-1093 to prevent gas blow-by to LPG treating.
5. Line numbers: <NPS>-<fluid>-<area>-<seq>-<class>-<insulation> per CONVENTIONS; see line list CFU-000-PI-LL-001.
6. All vents / drains 3/4" min. with blind or cap; HPV/LPD to piping specification. Valve sizes = line size UNO.
7. Instrument tags per ISA-5.1; index CFU-000-IC-IDX-001. SIS functions per SRS (SIF tags shown in interlocks).
SHELL: Unstab. naphtha / TUBE: Stabiliser bottoms
214 m2 bare; 1 bay(s) 6 m x 12 m, 2 fans
MAT'L CS tubes, Al fins (A-101: CS + inlet ferrules, Ti optional)
ID 1.7 m x 5.5 m T/T; boot ID 0.6 m x 1.5 m
